vector_memory.semantic_summary: ProgramConfig is the central configuration service responsible for managing all application runtime parameters. It orchestrates the loading process by reading user-specific JSON files, merging them with hardcoded defaults, and ensuring necessary directories (like logs and workspaces) exist. It provides strongly-typed access to settings via the ProgramSetting Enum, acting as the single source of truth for the entire application state.
